title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
text: Fed up with ads, tracking and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
text: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
text: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
text: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
text: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
text: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.

title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
text: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

title: Benefit Street Partners answers questions faster with Codex
text: Anant Kumar builds tools to compare loan valuations and analyze credit agreements, using Codex for code review and faster follow-ups.
